scope: auth PostgreSQL production R2DBC provider and database configuration boundary

implementation.change: Add org.postgresql:r2dbc-postgresql with runtime scope, no explicit version; Spring Boot 3.5.15 dependency management resolves 1.0.9.RELEASE.
implementation.before: apex-auth runtime supplied H2/MySQL only; auth-service obtained PostgreSQL R2DBC only through its test-scoped apex-system dependency.

tdd.initial_attempt: 3 tests, 2 assertion failures: PostgreSQL missing provider plus incorrect H2 options missing mem protocol. Corrected H2 to parsed r2dbc:h2:mem:///auth before implementation.

meaningful_red.failure: Only PostgreSQL provider unavailable; MySQL and H2 pass.

configuration_boundary.base_and_prod_default: MySQL JDBC driver/url and Flyway mysql location; prod adds MySQL R2DBC URL. No automatic PostgreSQL vendor switch.
configuration_boundary.basic_runtime_profile: H2 JDBC/R2DBC and Flyway disabled; Maven build tier is distinct from runtime profile.
configuration_boundary.credentials: Supply both spring.datasource and spring.r2dbc username/password; prod DB_USERNAME/DB_PASSWORD placeholders must resolve.
configuration_boundary.db_host_port_name_only: Does not change vendor; overriding only one URL can split JDBC/Flyway and R2DBC targets.
configuration_boundary.flyway: No separate spring.flyway.url in auth resources. Minimal probe explicitly wires DataSource from DataSourceProperties and Flyway consumes that JDBC DataSource.
configuration_boundary.production_transport: Probe uses loopback disposable PostgreSQL without TLS. Production JDBC sslmode and R2DBC sslMode/TLS trust settings still require deployment-specific validation. Existing MySQL TLS query parameters must not be copied to PG URLs.
configuration_boundary.no_config_default_change: Preserve MySQL defaults and Spring standard property override mechanism; no new vendor selector or environment aliases added. Nacos/Compose final property injection not verified.
